snippet.title: Stack & Brew // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596560/Stack_Brew

Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer:  BODOS
📚 Publisher:  Rock Paper Publisher, Gamersky Games
📅 Early Access Release Date: Nov 4, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Early Access
